loopIdea: It already returns: the ribbed belt and pulley the reel opens on spinning in the dim bay are the same belt and pulley coasting to a stop in the last beat, framed the same way, so a replay picks them straight back up at speed.
mechanicTruth: A power steering whine is aerated fluid: when the reservoir runs low the pump draws air in with the fluid, and that air moving through the pump vanes is the sound, loudest on turns because that is when the pump works hardest. Run it that way and the aerated fluid wears the pump seals.
